svg.title: PDDL planner or LLM agent
svg.desc: Five horizontal axes, each with a name on the left and words at both ends; the left end is marked better for the cell. Cost per decision: none to tokens or GPU time. Same input, same plan: always to not guaranteed. Why this plan: domain file to model weights. Latency per decision: planner run to network, generation. On these four axes marker 1 (PDDL planner, gray) is at the left end and marker 2 (LLM agent, blue) at the right end. Cases outside the domain: can try them to only modeled actions; here marker 2 is at the left end and marker 1 at the right end.
